# RemoteCC

> RemoteCC is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) interface for Claude Code: a small bridge runs next to the Claude Code CLI
> on your own computer (macOS, Linux, Windows via WSL2), and a web app at https://remotecc.dev — or served locally by the bridge at
> http://127.0.0.1:7791 — lets you start, watch and answer Claude Code sessions from any browser or phone. End-to-end
> encrypted (X25519 + AES-256-GCM), blind relay, no account, signed releases. It also shows Claude plan usage left,
> tokens and cost per session, and the computer's RAM, CPU temperature and disk.

Install on the computer that runs Claude Code: `curl -fsSL https://remotecc.dev/install.sh | bash`, then open https://remotecc.dev there (it pairs
by itself) or run `remotecc pair` and scan the QR code from a phone.

## Docs for agents
- [Install guide](https://remotecc.dev/install.md): steps an AI agent (e.g. Claude Code) can follow to install and pair RemoteCC
- [Windows (WSL2) guide](https://remotecc.dev/windows.md): install on Windows through WSL2
- [Claude Code remote control](https://remotecc.dev/claude-code-remote-control.md): Control Claude Code remotely from your phone or any browser. RemoteCC is a free, open-source bridge — sessions run on your own computer, end-to-end encrypted, no account.
- [Claude Code on iPhone](https://remotecc.dev/claude-code-on-iphone.md): Use Claude Code from your iPhone or Android phone. Sessions run on your own Mac or PC; your phone is a touch-friendly remote, end-to-end encrypted. Free and open source.
- [Use Claude Code from a browser](https://remotecc.dev/claude-code-from-browser.md): A web interface for the Claude Code CLI on your own computer. Open sessions from any browser, see usage and machine health, end-to-end encrypted. Free, open source.
- [Claude Code over Tailscale](https://remotecc.dev/claude-code-over-tailscale.md): Reach Claude Code on your computer directly over your Tailscale tailnet from the RemoteCC web app. No relay in the path, still end-to-end encrypted.
- [How RemoteCC works](https://remotecc.dev/how-it-works.md): RemoteCC's architecture: a small bridge next to Claude Code on your computer, a static web app, and a relay that only forwards end-to-end encrypted data.
- [RemoteCC security](https://remotecc.dev/security.md): RemoteCC's security model for remote Claude Code access: X25519 + AES-256-GCM end to end, a blind relay, signed releases you can verify, secrets kept on your computer.

## Project
- [Source code](https://github.com/Remotecc-dev/remotecc): bridge, web app, relay, installer (Apache-2.0)
- [Privacy](https://remotecc.dev/privacy): what is stored where, aggregate cookieless visit counting
- Contact: support@remotecc.dev
